## Functions

### CollectAll

CollectAll collects native cursor pages up to Max (nil:10,000; pointer to zero:unlimited).
The page fetcher chooses page size; CollectOptions.Limit is not used by this cursor helper.

```go
func CollectAll[T any, C comparable](ctx context.Context, fetch func(context.Context, C) (CursorPage[T, C], error), initial C, opts CollectOptions) ([]T, error)
```

### GeneratePayloadHash

GeneratePayloadHash computes an HMAC-SHA256 hex digest for API key auth.

```go
func GeneratePayloadHash(payload, secret string) string
```

### IsNotFound

IsNotFound reports whether err is (or wraps) an SDK error for HTTP 404, or
one of the SDK's client-side "not found" lookups.

```go
func IsNotFound(err error) bool
```

### IsValidUUID

IsValidUUID tests whether a string is a valid RFC 4122 UUID.

```go
func IsValidUUID(value string) bool
```

### NewAISecSDKError

NewAISecSDKError creates a new SDK error with the given message and type.

```go
func NewAISecSDKError(message string, errorType ErrorType) *AISecSDKError
```

### NewConfig

NewConfig creates a Config, reading environment variables as fallbacks.

```go
func NewConfig(opts ...ConfigOption) *Config
```

### NewHTTPError

NewHTTPError creates an SDK error for a failed HTTP response, recording the
status code so callers can branch on it.

```go
func NewHTTPError(message string, errorType ErrorType, statusCode int) *AISecSDKError
```

### Null

Null sets a field to JSON null, such as clearing a nullable configuration.

```go
func Null[T any]() Optional[T]
```

### Paginate

Paginate visits native cursor pages until Next is absent or yield returns false.
Fetch must honor its context. Repeated cursors and more than 10,000 pages are errors.

```go
func Paginate[T any, C comparable](ctx context.Context, fetch func(context.Context, C) (CursorPage[T, C], error), initial C, yield func(T) bool) error
```

### ValidateJobID

ValidateJobID validates that a job ID is a valid UUID.

```go
func ValidateJobID(jobID string) error
```

### Value

Value sets a field, including an explicit empty string, zero, or false.

```go
func Value[T any](value T) Optional[T]
```

### WithAPIKey

WithAPIKey sets the API key for HMAC-SHA256 auth.

```go
func WithAPIKey(key string) ConfigOption
```

### WithAPIToken

WithAPIToken sets the bearer token for auth.

```go
func WithAPIToken(token string) ConfigOption
```

### WithEndpoint

WithEndpoint overrides the default scan API endpoint.

```go
func WithEndpoint(endpoint string) ConfigOption
```

### WithHTTPClient

WithHTTPClient sets the HTTP client used for scan requests (custom timeouts,
transports, proxies, tracing). When unset the SDK uses its own default client.

```go
func WithHTTPClient(client *http.Client) ConfigOption
```

### WithNumRetries

WithNumRetries sets the max retry count (clamped to 0–MaxNumberOfRetries).

```go
func WithNumRetries(n int) ConfigOption
```

### WrapError

WrapError creates a new SDK error wrapping an existing error.

```go
func WrapError(message string, errorType ErrorType, err error) *AISecSDKError
```

## AISecSDKError

AISecSDKError is the base error type for all SDK errors.

```go
type AISecSDKError struct {
	ErrorType	ErrorType
	Message		string
	Err		error	// wrapped error for errors.Is/As support
	// StatusCode is the HTTP status of the failing response, or 0 when the
	// error did not originate from an HTTP response (validation, network, ...).
	// One exception: client-side lookups with no server endpoint (for example
	// Profiles.GetByID) report "not found" with 404 so errors.Is(err,
	// ErrNotFound) behaves identically for server and client-side misses; their
	// ErrorType remains ClientSideError.
	StatusCode	int
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### AISecSDKError.Error

Error implements the error interface.

```go
func (e *AISecSDKError) Error() string
```

### AISecSDKError.Is

Is reports whether target is the sentinel for this error's HTTP status, so
callers can write errors.Is(err, aisec.ErrNotFound).

```go
func (e *AISecSDKError) Is(target error) bool
```

### AISecSDKError.Unwrap

Unwrap supports errors.Is and errors.As.

```go
func (e *AISecSDKError) Unwrap() error
```

## Optional

Optional represents an omitted field, an explicit JSON null, or a value.
It is used by current-schema models whose generated MarshalJSON methods omit
unset fields. Plain encoding/json does not omit an unset Optional in a caller's
own struct: callers must implement their containing struct's omission policy.

```go
type Optional[T any] struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

### Optional.Get

Get returns the non-null value and whether it exists.

```go
func (o Optional[T]) Get() (T, bool)
```

### Optional.IsNull

IsNull reports an explicitly provided JSON null.

```go
func (o Optional[T]) IsNull() bool
```

### Optional.IsSet

IsSet reports whether the field was provided, including explicit null.

```go
func (o Optional[T]) IsSet() bool
```

### Optional.MarshalJSON

MarshalJSON encodes the value or null. Containing generated models omit unset
fields before returning the final object.

```go
func (o Optional[T]) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
```

### Optional.UnmarshalJSON

UnmarshalJSON records explicit null separately from a missing field.

```go
func (o *Optional[T]) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error
```
